subtasks.title: Make the Org Map "No kits reporting GPS" notice dismissible (✕ on the centered card, hides both surfaces, session-scoped)
subtasks.approach: In resources/js/clarity-scout/App.vue: (1) add `const noticeDismissed = ref(false)` in <script setup> (import `ref` — already imported alongside computed/watch). (2) Change BOTH notice v-if conditions from `noKitsReporting` to `noKitsReporting && !noticeDismissed` (centered card line ~37, bottom pill line ~81). (3) Add a close ✕ button inside the centered card (lines 37-48), mirroring Toast.vue's dismiss convention: type=button, aria-label="Dismiss", the same X-path SVG (w-4 h-4), positioned top-right of the card; give the BUTTON `pointer-events-auto` (leave the outer container `pointer-events-none` so the map stays draggable around it); `@click="noticeDismissed = true"`. No watcher, no localStorage/sessionStorage — the ref resets naturally on a fresh App mount (page reload / new session), matching Dalton's session-scoped choice. `noKitsReporting` computed (330-336) is unchanged, so AC3 (auto-hide when kits report) still holds.
subtasks.intended_diffs: App.vue: +noticeDismissed ref in script setup; two v-if edits (card + pill) to `&& !noticeDismissed`; a new absolutely-positioned ✕ button (pointer-events-auto) inside the centered card that sets noticeDismissed=true. Then `npm run build` to regenerate + commit public/build assets.

excluded_sites.reason: Unchanged — reactive trigger stays as-is; AC3 relies on it. Only the v-if consumers gain the `&& !noticeDismissed` guard.
